body.statement: If \(\mathcal C_P\neq\varnothing\), then WAOSS is point identified if and only if \(\Theta(P)\) is a singleton, if and only if \(V_P^+=V_P^-\), if and only if \(R(P)=0\).
body.justification: This corollary records the exact singleton condition implied by the attained endpoint formula and is not presented as an independent diagnostic or novelty claim.
body.gap: The published conditional-support results give sufficient singleton regimes; this algebraic corollary only records when the new sharp interval collapses.
body.consumer: Researchers can report whether the computed sharp obstacle interval is a singleton without attributing additional identifying content to a reparameterized width condition.
